core_obligations: Surjectivity: the image of an irreducible component is irreducible and contained in a component of the target, and surjectivity upgrades the containment to an equality (proof lines 1172-1175)
Injectivity: the preimage of a component is irreducible and contained in a component of the source mapping onto it, which forces the two components to be the same (proof lines 1176-1180)
proof_roadmap: 满射性：分支的像不可约（image-irreducible-space）⇒ 含于某个分支；由满射该分支的这些原像覆盖它 ⇒ 相等。
单射性：分支的原像不可约（需纤维不可约）⇒ 含于某个分支，而后者映满前者 ⇒ 两分支相同。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a continuous surjection with irreducible fibres induces a bijection between the irreducible components of source and target (author lemma at source lines 1165-1170, label lemma-surjective-continuous-irreducible-components). The proof (source lines 1172-1181) uses the two statements on images and preimages of irreducible subsets to get surjectivity and injectivity of the induced map (proof lines 1172-1180). The two applications are the substance. H3.
